# Simple Valid Polygon

A straightforward, well-formed polygon with no holes, no self- intersections, and a standard CRS. Serves as the baseline "happy path" for geometry loading and validation.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `simple_valid_polygon` |
| Category | vector |
| Format | GeoJSON |
| Geometry type | Polygon |
| CRS | `EPSG:4326` |
| Test tier | unit |
| Size class | tiny |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `geopandas` |
| Status | validated |


## What this case checks

Confirm that a minimal valid polygon loads without error and passes all standard geometry checks.
